archetypes.name: step5-contract
archetypes.rationale: The change crosses prompt orchestration, Python CLI stdout, and retired-script lint contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 5 contract end to end. Check that the banner remains byte-compatible, appears once, and uses the same dynamic-archetype cap as review dispatch. Verify failure paths do not print misleading banners. Cite each finding with a file path and line number from this repository. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retirement-cleanliness
archetypes.rationale: Deleting a shipped wrapper can leave stale references that only surface in lint or consumer docs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on retired-script hygiene and structure-test coverage. Check that no live file references the deleted step-5-entry paths outside the retired manifest. Verify the orchestrator now has one standard Step 5 review-loop Bash call. Cite each finding with a file path and line number from this repository. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
